guide.summary: Marble Mountains, Ba Na Hills and the city's museums, with breakfast spots, Michelin-listed dinners, rooftop and resort bars, a bakery and specialty coffee checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: None of the confirmed venues publishes a weekly closing day, and the Museum of Cham Sculpture and Da Nang Museum both list daily hours, but check where Marble Mountains tickets are sold, because its board posted a notice on 3 November 2026 about moving its central ticket point.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Museum of Cham Sculpture opens 07:00–17:00 daily and the Da Nang Museum and Fine Arts Museum 08:00–17:00 daily. Madame Lân serves 6:30–21:30 Monday to Sunday and Sky36 opens 18:00–02:00 every day.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Museum of Cham Sculpture charges 60,000 VND per person per visit. Ba Na Hills sells tickets through booking.sunworld.vn and says its 08:00–22:00 hours may change.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Madame Lân, Olivia's Prime Steakhouse and Sky36 all take reservations online or by phone. La Maison 1888, Citron and The Long Bar are booked through the InterContinental's dining enquiry form.

toolkit.label: Children
toolkit.copy: The Novotel Danang Premier Han River lists its breakfast buffet at VND 470,000 per guest and VND 235,000 for children aged 6–12. The InterContinental says kids under 6 eat free from the Kids' Menu.

guide.dek: Plan museums and Marble Mountains for daytime and book Da Nang's Michelin-listed dinners and rooftop tables ahead.
intro: Start with the city's museums, which all publish daily hours. The Museum of Cham Sculpture on 2 Tháng 9 Street opens 07:00–17:00 every day and charges 60,000 VND per visit; in July 2026 it announced the opening of a themed exhibition on Cham cultural traces in Lâm Đồng. The Da Nang Museum at 31 Trần Phú and the Fine Arts Museum at 78 Lê Duẩn both open 08:00–17:00 daily, while Branch 2 on Phan Bội Châu, which opened a botanical exhibition on 6 October 2026, closes for a midday break.

For the big sights, Marble Mountains is run by its own management board at 81 Huyền Trân Công Chúa, which posted a notice on 3 November 2026 about changing its central ticket-sales point, so you should confirm where to buy before you climb. Ba Na Hills lists hours of 08:00–22:00, warns that they may change, and sells tickets through Sun World's booking site. In town, Da Nang Cathedral sits at 156 Trần Phú, the same address as the diocese, which held its All Saints Mass there on 2 November 2026.

Several of the confirmed dining rooms sit on Bạch Đằng. Madame Lân at No. 4 serves from 6:30 to 21:30 every day and says it has been Michelin Selected from 2024 to 2026, so it works for breakfast as well as lunch. Olivia's Prime Steakhouse in Indochina Mall is also listed in the MICHELIN Guide for 2026. On the Son Tra Peninsula, La Maison 1888 at the InterContinental holds one Michelin star, and Citron serves dishes from Vietnam's north, centre and south; both are booked through the resort's enquiry form.

For drinks, Sky36 occupies floors 35 to 37 of the Novotel tower on Bạch Đằng and opens 18:00–02:00 every day, with DJs from 21:00. The Pullman's Infinity Bar serves afternoon tea from 13:00 to 17:00, and Restaurant Epice hosts a Christmas Eve buffet on 24 December 2026. For coffee, XLIII Coffee on Ngô Thì Sĩ opens 6:30–22:30, and if you visit nearby Hội An, XLIII has a branch there and Hoi An Roastery's main café at 135 Trần Phú opens 7:00–21:00 daily.
summaryCards: Pair the Museum of Cham Sculpture, open 07:00–17:00 daily, with Marble Mountains, and check the board's current ticket point first.
Start with breakfast at Madame Lân from 6:30 or coffee at XLIII Coffee on Ngô Thì Sĩ from 6:30, then walk to the Da Nang Museum, open 08:00–17:00 daily.
Reserve Madame Lân, Sky36 or Olivia's Prime by phone or online, and use the InterContinental's enquiry form for La Maison 1888, since none of these publishes a weekly closing day.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several sites could not be read: Highlands Coffee, Starbucks, Hyatt and Hilton returned 403; Pizza 4P's had a certificate error; Bread of Life, Nén Danang and Naman Retreat did not resolve; Tous les Jours and Hải Sản Bé Mặn refused connections; the KATINAT store list did not load. Some confirmed places are published only partially: Marble Mountains, the InterContinental restaurants and bar, Olivia's Prime, Novotel and TIA give no opening hours; Da Nang Cathedral is confirmed only through the diocese site at the same address, without Mass times; Ba Hưng Bakery states one set of hours for all branches; the Pullman Infinity Bar's general hours were cut off; Furama's booking hours come from a restaurants page dated 30 May 2025; and Reaching Out's hours come from a location page that also carries an older Tết notice. Hội An places are now within Da Nang city, as the operators' own addresses show. Several fetch summaries reported AI-directed text that matched this review's own request wording, so it was treated as a tool artefact rather than page content.
